UserPrivate.title: UserPrivate
UserPrivate.description: Isolated private user record storing PII (email) and personal key fingerprint. Accessible strictly by the document owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

keyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the active ECDH P-256 public key.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public cryptographic identity directory entry containing zero PII. Publishes ECDH P-256 public key coordinates for Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in directory and conversations.

handle.description: Unique-style alphanumeric handle for peer lookup.

publicKeyX.description: Base64URL X coordinate of the user's ECDH P-256 public key.

publicKeyY.description: Base64URL Y coordinate of the user's ECDH P-256 public key.

keyFingerprint.description: Formatted SHA-256 fingerprint of the ECDH P-256 public key.

discoverable.description: Whether this profile can be queried in the public key directory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: End-to-end encrypted 1-to-1 communication channel between participantA and participantB.

id.description: Deterministic or random conversation document ID.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the channel. 'locked' is a terminal state.

lastCiphertextPreview.description: Truncated ciphertext indicator of the latest encrypted packet.

messageCount.description: Total count of encrypted packets transmitted in this session.

lastSenderId.description: UID of the participant who performed the latest channel mutation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest channel mutation.

EncryptedMessage.title: EncryptedMessage
EncryptedMessage.description: Individual AES-256-GCM encrypted packet stored inside a conversation subcollection.

senderId.description: UID of the sender who encrypted the message.

senderKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of sender's public key at encryption time.

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext and authentication tag.

deliveryStatus.description: Packet delivery state. 'revoked' is a terminal state.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when packet was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when packet state was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user vault containing PII (email). Strictly restricted to document owner.

/profiles/{userId}.description: Public cryptographic identity and ECDH P-256 public key directory (no PII).

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: End-to-end encrypted communication sessions between two verified users.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted message frames belonging to a conversation.
